verdict.rationale: mParticle's own docs show bulk-style data operations: Warehouse Sync ingests data in bulk from Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery and Databricks, and the Events API accepts events in batches. These cover bulk ingestion rather than general bulk actions such as editing, deleting or updating many records at once. missing for 10: documented bulk update/delete or mass-edit operations across many items, bulk operations on audiences or other platform objects, limits or scale documentation for batch endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
